Subject: Weekly checkpoint: go-live checklist & final assignments (launch 2026-08-06)

Team —

Quick weekly checkpoint and final go-live checklist following our Tue sync. Launch scheduled for 2026-08-06 in the 02:00–05:00 ET window unless we hear blockers by 2026-08-03 17:00 ET.

Final runbook & key owners:
- Runbook owner: Karthik Iyer — includes warmup steps, health checks, and audit-log export example. (Deliverable: runbook_v1.md in Drive)
- MAP owner: Marissa Cole — final sign-off checklist and stakeholder approvals captured in MAP_v1.xlsx.
- Rollback owner: Ben Carter — automated rollback rules (error rate & latency thresholds) and verification playbook.
- Customer liaison: Evelyn Hart — coordinates go/no-go and escalations.

Go-live checklist (high-level):
1) Pre-cutover
   - Confirm reserved capacity and GPU quotas (Evelyn) — DONE pending billing confirmation.
   - Smoke test on staging with production-like load (Karthik) — target 2026-08-04.
   - SOC2 evidence and audit export validated by customer (Karthik + Priya) — target 2026-07-30 (in progress).

2) Cutover (02:00–05:00 ET, 2026-08-06)
   - Begin traffic ramp at 02:00 ET with 10% initial traffic; monitor p50/p95 latency and error rate.
   - At 02:30 ET increase to 50% if metrics good; full 100% by 03:30 ET if stable.
   - If error rate > 5% sustained for 10m or p50 latency > 2s, trigger automated rollback (Ben).

3) Post-cutover verification
   - Run regression prompt set (Marissa) — pass/fail by 04:30 ET.
   - End-to-end business flows sanity check (customer) — sign-off captured in MAP_v1.xlsx.

Escalation & rollback notes:
- Automated rollback will pivot traffic to the prior model variant and notify the on-call infra lead.
- If automated path fails, manual rollback protocol: stop traffic, restore prior config, escalate to CTO pager.

Open items (need before 2026-08-03 17:00 ET):
- Billing confirmation for reserved capacity (Evelyn to update Finance).
- Final SOC2 evidence export format approval (Priya / NovaHealth).
- DocuSign for updated SOW (Evelyn coordinating). Link to envelope: https://docusign.net/DocuSign/EnvelopeStatus?envelopeId=4a3b2c

Next steps:
- Karthik: push runbook_v1.md to Drive (target 2026-07-30).
- Marissa: publish MAP_v1.xlsx and request stakeholder sign-off (target 2026-07-30).
- Ben: finish rollback automation tests (target 2026-07-31).

If there are any blockers that prevent us from locking 2026-08-06, flag here immediately. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the plan and share the final runbook to all stakeholders on 2026-07-31.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
